QuestInfo.0: Check to see if the new picture came out right.
QuestInfo.1: There's too much going on in the picture. Francis is sure to hate it, as picky as he is. Get on the bus and follow Orchid to the #bDrizzling Strolling Path#k to take another picture.
QuestInfo.2: The bus brought you to the #bDrizzling Strolling Path#k. Lily explains that Orchid's emotions might be manifesting the monsters.
